title: Exam Technique and Final Review

header.html: All domains: time plan, chooser tables, look-alike terms and decision rules
Exam technique across all four domains: a time plan for 100 minutes; a chooser table for the layer that solves a problem; numbers to memorize; look-alike terms; five questions for every scenario
the official PL-300 study guide (skills measured as of April 20, 2026)

html:
1Time plan and method

The exam lasts 100 minutes, and you need 700 on a scale to 1,000 to pass. It is proctored. The study guide says it may include interactive components, so do not assume every item is multiple choice. Plan by minutes, not by item count.

Phase Minutes What to do
Settle About 5 Read the instructions; note any interactive components
First pass About 65 Answer what you know; if an item is unclear after about 2 minutes, mark it and move on
Second pass About 25 Return to the marked items and use the five questions in section 5
Final check About 5 Make sure nothing is unanswered; reread words such as "first" and "least"

The method for every item has four steps:

  1. Read the last sentence first. It says what to deliver: a feature, a first step or a result.
  2. Read the scenario and underline the requirements: storage mode, license, who the user is, what must not change.
  3. Cross out every option that breaks one requirement.
  4. Pick the simplest built-in feature that meets all of them.
Exam tip

. Mark and return: if you cannot decide in about 2 minutes, give your best answer, mark the item and move on. An unanswered item can never score.

2Which layer solves it

Most scenario questions are really "which layer?" in disguise.

Layer Choose it when Typical tools
Power Query Data must be cleaned or shaped before it loads Data types, remove rows and columns, pivot and unpivot, merge and append, parameters, privacy levels
Model The problem is tables, relationships or properties Star schema, cardinality, cross-filter direction, date table, sort by column, RLS roles
DAX A value must be calculated and follow filters Measures, CALCULATE, time intelligence, calculated columns and tables, calculation groups, visual calculations
Report The problem is what users see and do Visual choice, formatting, slicers, bookmarks, drillthrough, themes, accessibility, AI visuals, Copilot
Service The problem is sharing, schedule or security Workspaces, apps, refresh, gateways, subscriptions, alerts, endorsement, labels, RLS members

Shape before load, relate in the model, calculate in DAX, show in the report, share and secure in the service. When both work, prefer a Power Query column to a DAX calculated column, because it compresses better. Use a measure when the result must respond to filters.

Exam tip

. Name the layer before you read the options. If the fix is a ratio that must stay correct at every total, it is a measure, not a column.

3Numbers to memorize

Number What it is
8 and 48 Scheduled refreshes a day: Pro up to 8; PPU, Premium and Fabric up to 48
1,000 rows Default for column profiling; switch to the entire data set in the status bar
1,000,000 rows A DirectQuery query that returns more than 1,000,000 rows fails
250 characters Maximum length of alt text
4.5 to 1 Minimum contrast ratio for text
24 and 250 Email subscriptions per item; data alerts
F2 or P1 Smallest paid capacity for Copilot: Fabric F2 or Premium P1
4 failures Consecutive refresh failures that disable a schedule
100 and 700 Exam minutes; passing score on a scale to 1,000
Exam tip

. Pro: 8 refreshes a day. PPU, Premium, Fabric: 48. Direct Lake and Copilot questions usually hide a capacity requirement: look for Fabric F2 or higher, or Premium P1 or higher.

4Look-alike pairs

Prepare and model:

Pair The difference in one line
Import, DirectQuery, Direct Lake Import copies data into the model; DirectQuery queries the source for each visual; Direct Lake reads Delta tables in OneLake on Fabric capacity
Reference and duplicate Reference starts from another query's output, so changes flow through; duplicate copies the steps as an independent query
Merge and append Merge adds columns by matching keys; append stacks rows from queries with the same columns
Calculated column and measure A column is computed per row at refresh and stored; a measure is computed at query time and follows filter context

Visualize and manage:

Pair The difference in one line
Bookmark and drillthrough A bookmark saves a view; drillthrough opens a detail page filtered to the chosen data point
Slicer and filter A slicer is a visual on the page; a filter lives in the Filters pane at visual, page or report level
Viewer and Contributor under RLS RLS restricts Viewers only; a Contributor sees every row
Promoted and the higher level Owners can set Promoted; only authorized reviewers set the higher level
App and share An app is a curated set with audiences, one per workspace; a share link gives one item, Read by default
Dashboard and report A dashboard is one page of tiles built in the service; a report has pages, slicers and filters
Personal and standard gateway Personal: one user, Import refresh only; standard: shared, supports DirectQuery and live connection
Exam tip

. Under RLS only the Viewer role is restricted. Pair it with "Promoted is owner-set, the higher level is reviewer-set" and "one app per workspace" to settle most Manage questions.

5Five questions for every scenario

  1. What exactly is asked? A feature, a first step or a result.
  2. Which layer owns the problem? Power Query, model, DAX, report or service.
  3. Which facts limit the choice? Storage mode, license or capacity, where the source is, the user's role.
  4. Which options fail a requirement? Cross them out.
  5. Which option is the simplest built-in feature? Choose the least effort that meets every requirement.

6Exam Q&A

6.1 Practice questions (choose the best answer)

S1A retailer's fact table has hundreds of millions of rows in a Fabric lakehouse. Users need near current data and fast visuals without a long refresh. Which storage mode fits?

  • AImport mode with a scheduled refresh each day
  • BDirectQuery against the lakehouse SQL endpoint
  • CDirect Lake on the lakehouse Delta tables
  • DDual mode on the large fact table in the model
Show the answer

Answer: C. Direct Lake reads Delta tables in OneLake, its refresh copies only metadata, and visuals run on the VertiPaq engine like Import.

S2A finance team's model must show profit margin that stays correct at every level when users slice by Region or Product. What should the modeler create?

  • AA DAX calculated column that divides profit by sales per row
  • BA Power Query custom column that divides profit by sales
  • CA visual filter that hides rows with a blank margin
  • DA DAX measure that divides total profit by total sales
Show the answer

Answer: D. A measure is calculated at query time in the current filter context, so the ratio is correct at every total, while a per-row column is not.

S3Users of a regional sales page must right-click a region and jump to a detail page that is already filtered to that region. Which feature should you configure?

  • AA bookmark that saves the selected region
  • BA drillthrough page with the region field
  • CSync slicers across the two report pages
  • DA report page tooltip for the region chart
Show the answer

Answer: B. Drillthrough opens a detail page filtered to the chosen data point, while a bookmark only restores a saved view.

S4A department wants 300 colleagues to open a curated set of reports and dashboards, with different content for two groups. What should an Admin use?

  • AA workspace app with two audiences
  • BA Contributor role for every colleague
  • CA share link for each report and dashboard
  • DAn email subscription for every colleague
Show the answer

Answer: A. An app delivers curated content, and audiences control which content each group sees.

S5An analyst has twelve monthly files with identical columns and needs one table that holds all rows. Which transformation should the analyst use?

  • AMerge the queries on a key column
  • BPivot the month column in each query
  • CGroup the rows by month in each query
  • DAppend the queries into one table
Show the answer

Answer: D. Append stacks the rows of queries that have the same columns, whereas merge adds columns by matching keys.

S6During the exam you cannot choose between two options after about 2 minutes. What should you do?

  • APick your best answer, mark the item and come back
  • BLeave it blank and review it only if time remains
  • CKeep working on it until you are fully certain
  • DAnswer it last and guess every remaining item
Show the answer

Answer: A. Marking the item with a best answer protects your score and saves minutes for the rest.

6.2 Recall questions

R1How long is the exam, and what score passes?

Show the answer

100 minutes; 700 on a scale to 1,000.

R2How many scheduled refreshes a day do Pro and Premium allow?

Show the answer

Pro up to 8; PPU, Premium and Fabric up to 48.

R3What happens to a DirectQuery query that returns more than 1,000,000 rows?

Show the answer

It fails.

R4What is the maximum length of alt text?

Show the answer

250 characters.

R5What is the minimum contrast ratio for text?

Show the answer

4.5 to 1.

R6What is the smallest paid capacity that supports Copilot?

Show the answer

Fabric F2 or Premium P1.

7Quick Reference Card

Topic Key fact
Time plan 100 minutes: about 5 settle, 65 first pass, 25 second pass, 5 final check; mark and return
Method read the last sentence first; underline requirements; cross out; pick the simplest built-in feature
Layers Power Query shapes; model relates; DAX calculates; report shows; service shares and secures
Refresh and limits 8 or 48 refreshes; 1,000 profiling rows; 1,000,000 DirectQuery rows; 4 failures disable
Accessibility and sharing 250 characters alt text; 4.5 to 1 contrast; 24 subscriptions; 250 alerts
Capacity and score Copilot needs F2 or P1; 100 minutes; 700 to pass
Look-alikes Viewer only under RLS; Promoted versus the higher level; app versus share; personal versus standard gateway
